runs.question: Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_06b297e5cffeq9HYlwv3ooKvvU] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
Here are the results for mainnet blocks on **June 20, 2026 (UTC)**:

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| **Total slots** | 7,180 |
| **Slot range** | 14,590,799 – 14,597,998 |
| **Date range** | 00:00:11 – 23:59:59 UTC |
| **Avg first-seen arrival** | 1,710 ms |
| **Median arrival** | 1,453 ms |
| **Min arrival** | 141 ms |
| **Max arrival** | 5,249 ms |

Each slot's first-seen arrival time (`seen_slot_start_diff` in ms) is the minimum delay from slot start at which any node first observed the block, aggregated per slot from `mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node`.

[Turn 2 | session=ses_06b297e5cffeq9HYlwv3ooKvvU] Plot the distribution of those arrival times as a chart.
The chart is ready:
